payload.text: Report to intent-vc when a session is up (none on 21 Oct): (1) Intent's post-merge, post-checkout and post-rewrite hooks run intent sync in a git worktree's own store, which can predate main, so intent/ views in the worktree go backwards (cc's watchout 2); (2) 'intent at list | grep -q' panics on the broken pipe instead of exiting quietly.
